remarks: Beautifully renovated and completely move-in ready, this top-floor penthouse suite combines modern elegance with everyday comfort. Inside, you'll find two well-proportioned bedrooms and a full bathroom, all enhanced by stylish finishes and thoughtful updates. The open-concept living and dining area offers an easy flow, ideal for both entertaining and quiet nights in. The updated kitchen serves as the centerpiece of the home, featuring sleek quartz counters, an Aquasana reverse osmosis water filtration system, and a counter-depth refrigerator. From the kitchen window, enjoy peaceful glimpses of the Long Island Sound as you start your day. The bathroom, recently updated, features a heated floor and a custom glass-enclosed shower surrounded by designer tile. Step out onto your private balcony and take in the treetop views - the perfect place to unwind or admire the changing seasons. Storage is never an issue with generous closet space and an additional dedicated storage unit in the basement. Located just a short 10-minute walk from downtown Stamford, this home offers easy access to Bedford Street's popular dining, cafes, and vibrant atmosphere. Whether enjoying summer evenings outdoors or watching the fall colors unfold from your balcony, this property delivers a refined yet relaxed lifestyle in an unbeatable location.
